summary: NICE Ltd. furnished a routine Form 6-K (the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K) covering September 2026, attaching three customer and award press releases: AOK PLUS going live on NiCE Cognigy and CXone supporting over 5 million annual member interactions, Merlin Entertainments deploying CXone, and a Fast Company workplace recognition. No special-situation transaction, stake, price or board action is disclosed; the filing is ordinary business-update disclosure. What to watch: nothing deal-related — purely operational publicity, not a risk-arb catalyst.
